meta.tagline: Know the ballpark cost before you go.
meta.description: Compare hospital prices in San Diego, estimate what you'll pay with your insurance, and find help if money is tight.

footer.disclaimer: Estimates, not quotes. Prices come from files hospitals are required to publish and may be out of date. Your actual bill depends on the care you receive and your plan. This is not medical, legal, or insurance advice.
footer.emergency: In an emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room. Don't let cost stop you.
footer.cpt: CPT® is a registered trademark of the American Medical Association. Service descriptions on this site are our own plain-language summaries.

home.title: Know the ballpark cost before you go
home.intro: Hospitals must publish their prices, but the files are huge and hard to read. We turn them into a simple range so you can plan ahead, compare, and avoid surprise bills.
home.ctaHelp: No insurance or low income? Find help
home.how1: Pick a service, like an office visit, MRI, or blood test.
home.how2: See the cash price and what insurers typically pay at each hospital.
home.how3: Add your plan details to estimate what you would owe.
home.coverageBody: We're starting with UC San Diego Health and adding more San Diego hospitals next, then the rest of Southern California and the state.

about.title: How it works
about.sourcesBody: Federal law (45 CFR Part 180) requires every hospital to publish a machine-readable file of its standard charges: list prices, cash prices, and the rates negotiated with each insurer. We download these files, check them, and summarize them. We show the date each hospital last updated its file.
about.estimatesBody: We look for your insurer's negotiated rate for your plan type at that hospital. If it isn't listed, we fall back to your insurer's other plans, then to the range across all insurers, and we tell you when we do. Then we apply your deductible, coinsurance or copay, and out-of-pocket maximum. We always show a range because the final bill depends on the care you actually get.
about.limitsBody: Hospital files cover hospital charges. Doctors, anesthesiologists, and labs that bill separately may not be included. Prices at independent clinics and imaging centers are often lower — it's worth asking.
about.privacyBody: You don't need an account. Plan details, income, and household answers are calculated in your browser and are never sent to or stored on our servers.
about.accessibilityBody: We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. If something is hard to use with your device or assistive technology, please tell us.
